decision: Additive-only write-API over existing grant + role_assignment tables. New module src/http/grants.ts registers POST /api/grants, POST /api/grants/:id/revoke, POST /api/role-assignments, POST /api/role-assignments/:id/revoke — each gated by validateAdminDelegation (imported verbatim from scoped-admin.ts). AdminContext (isGenesisOwner, adminGrants, adminOrgScope) is DB-resolved via two new helpers in src/db/org.ts. Grant INSERT + GrantAuditEvent INSERT run in a single withTenant transaction. Migration 030 adds proposed_by/confirmed_by columns to the existing grant table (no new table). Existing ra-role-editor.jsx is wired via onSubmit handler. GET /api/rights/dictionaries serves seed-backed closed dictionaries.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: validateAdminDelegation is pure and designed to be called inline before INSERT — a network hop adds latency and deployment complexity with zero semantic benefit.

rejected_alternatives.option: Persist preset expansions in a preset table
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Presets are a UI convenience. Expanding them client-side before POST produces identical structural atoms as advanced mode. A separate table contradicts the capability-not-text principle and adds unnecessary DDL (AC-18 / spec §4 out-of-scope).

rejected_alternatives.option: Use actor_event table for audit emit
rejected_alternatives.why_not: actor_event is the SoD substrate for guarded transitions (T-0019). Grant writes are mgmt_object:grant management writes, not guarded transitions. The correct target is audit_event (T-0016 floor) via GrantAuditEvent (T-0018 FR-7, frozen).

rejected_alternatives.option: Fire-and-forget audit emit after transaction commit
rejected_alternatives.why_not: A committed grant row with no audit record is a silent audit gap. Wrapping both INSERTs in one transaction ensures atomicity (T-0062 lesson).

rejected_alternatives.option: Load admin context via existing grant-resolver.ts (T-0021)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: grant-resolver.ts is PDP/read-path code explicitly not edited (T-0029 NF-6). The write-path needs a narrower helper for the acting principal's mgmt-grants only — loadAdminContext in src/db/org.ts is the correct seam.

fitness_functions.ci_check: grep -n 'GrantAuditEvent' src/http/grants.ts | grep 'import' | grep 'grant-lattice'; grep -rn 'GrantAuditEvent' src/ | grep -v 'grant-lattice\|grants.ts\|\.test\.' must be empty

fitness_functions.rule: isGenesisOwner is never hardcoded to true outside src/db/org.ts
fitness_functions.ci_check: grep -rn 'isGenesisOwner.*true\|isGenesisOwner: true' src/ | grep -v 'src/db/org\.ts' must be empty

fitness_functions.rule: validateAdminDelegation is not re-implemented — no scope_widens / facet_widens / org_scope_widens literals outside scoped-admin.ts and test files
fitness_functions.ci_check: grep -rn 'scope_widens\|facet_widens\|org_scope_widens' src/ | grep -v 'scoped-admin\.ts\|grants\.ts\|\.test\.' must be empty (grants.ts may reference the reason string in error forwarding only)

fitness_functions.rule: Every parameterized INSERT INTO choros."grant" and INSERT INTO choros.role_assignment in grants.ts has tenant_id as the leading ($1) parameter
fitness_functions.ci_check: Integration tests AC-01 / AC-09 assert tenant_id on inserted row; static: grep -A5 'INSERT INTO choros' src/http/grants.ts | grep -E '\$1' must match on tenant_id position

fitness_functions.rule: No new tenant table introduced — known_tenant_tables.txt unchanged; grant and role_assignment already listed
fitness_functions.ci_check: wc -l ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt equals 21; grep '^grant$' ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt and grep '^role_assignment$' ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt both exit 0

fitness_functions.rule: The grant INSERT and the GrantAuditEvent audit_event INSERT are inside the same transaction — client.release() must not appear between them
fitness_functions.ci_check: grep -n 'client.release\|COMMIT\|ROLLBACK' src/http/grants.ts — COMMIT appears exactly once per handler, after both INSERTs; no client.release() between INSERT and audit INSERT

fitness_functions.rule: parseScopeElement calls normalize() from grant-lattice.ts before returning a valid element — no raw ScopeElement returned without normalization
fitness_functions.ci_check: grep -n 'normalize(' src/http/grants.ts must appear in the parseScopeElement function body; import of normalize from grant-lattice.js present

fitness_functions.rule: No RLS bypass in the grants write-path
fitness_functions.ci_check: grep -rn 'BYPASS RLS\|SET ROLE\|choros_migrator\|superuser' src/http/grants.ts src/db/org.ts must be empty

fitness_functions.rule: validateAdminDelegation is called and checked before every INSERT — integration tests AC-02/03/04/08/10 assert zero rows inserted on rejection
fitness_functions.ci_check: Tests for AC-02, AC-03, AC-04, AC-08, AC-10 in the grants test file each assert: DB row count = 0 after rejected write; HTTP status = 403 with ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED
